title: Haze: Ricochet on all roles (fire rate, bounces vs 3 enemies, ult, bounce lifesteal) vs the same souls in greens
question: Section J: is Ricochet only a farming item? Measure each role separately against Extra Health + Fortitude + 3.2k banked (Kieran's Fortitude-first order) at the 12k decision point.
hypothesis: Model at 12k: Ricochet +29% 1v1 damage, +138% damage vs 3 enemies, ult vs 3 enemies x2.8, bounce damage heals if lifesteal applies to bounces; Fortitude +375 HP and ~3 s longer survival when focused. Prediction: 3-enemy damage with Ricochet >= 2x without; ult damage vs 3 >= 2x.

setup.start_hp: full; lowhp 50 for the heal block

controls: hardreset between blocks (fresh pawns, factory cooldowns/charges, unlock 7 = all 3 tiers on every ability in BOTH arms)
Same position (fetch 350, aimoff 5.5 3), same enemy bot (Haze), egod default floor
Arms interleaved A,B,A,B (counterbalanced A,B,B,A for the second half)
healreset + mark none around every reset
cast reload 2.5 before each fire block (no auto-reload op)
procedure: block A single target: enemies 1; cast reload 2.5; mark <arm>_1t; fire 4
block B: enemies 3 300; cast reload 2.5; mark <arm>_3t; fire 4
block D: enemies 3 300; lowhp 50; cast 2 0.3; mark <arm>_heal; fire 4; healsum; lowhp 0

decision.rule: Measures Ricochet's fight roles; the order decision (Ricochet before Fortitude) also needs farming speed and survival when focused, which are UNSUPPORTED (no camp spawn, bots never shoot): verdict on the order stays CALCULATED.

limitations: Checkpoint level/ability-tier states cannot be reproduced (unlock sets all tiers; GAPS #2): results are late-game relative comparisons only.
Farming (camp clear) UNSUPPORTED: no NPC/camp op (GAPS #21).
Survival under real focus UNSUPPORTED: bots never shoot; `incoming` is a smooth stream (GAPS #6/#17).
